documents.title: Paid revenue
documents.text: Paid revenue is the sum of amount_cents only for orders whose status is paid. Use zero when no orders qualify.

documents.title: Qualifying order list
documents.text: Only paid orders qualify. The minimum amount is inclusive. Start dates are inclusive and end dates exclusive. Sort by order ID.

documents.title: Monthly paid reporting
documents.text: Monthly revenue and counts include paid orders only. Month means the first seven characters of ordered_at, YYYY-MM. Omit months with no paid orders.

documents.title: Customer net revenue
documents.text: Customer net revenue equals paid order amounts minus approved refunds linked to those paid orders. Ignore pending refunds. Count each order and each refund once; aggregate before joining to prevent fan-out. Treat NULL refunds as zero. Include every customer, even without orders.

documents.title: Customers without purchases
documents.text: A customer has no purchase when no paid order exists for that customer. Cancelled orders do not count as purchases. Include customers with no orders at all.

documents.title: Leading customers
documents.text: Rank customers by total paid amount. Include customers with no paid orders as zero and include all ties for the highest total. Sort by customer ID.
